review.notes: Independent report5f7922fd/SHA357173420826622aa54ce507008d1cdaee79b51067338c170c27803db00208e7 correctly separates existing empty-path gap from regressions. Keep original MEX001-004 designs and tests unchanged; new files below add the missing counterexamples. Explicit manual refresh owns a15-second click-to-feedback deadline without cancelling shared background/trailing reads; owner tokens retire timeout/settle callbacks across new actions and client switches. Upload HTTP success and injected shared uploadAll results must reject empty/whitespace paths, retaining caption/images and explicit guarded retry. Preserve nonempty path exactly; do not assert remote file existence. Existing CI TS2551 fix is already committed and mobile CI has passed at a983; this review does not claim follow-up tests have run or provide independent approval. No dependency, local product tests/builds, real pane/device, permission, release, or Store183 mutation.

cases.description: Manual Radar retry has an independent click deadline and scoped ownership while the shared lane is occupied
cases.setup: Real AgentsProvider/RadarPanel/OfflineBanner with cached failed roster, controlled background SSE read, fake timers and deferred subsequent reads
cases.action: Click Retry during a background read; advance14999 then15000ms; click again while trailing read is pending; settle the old action, deliver expired responses, and exercise another SSE read and client switch
cases.expected: First action releases busy by15seconds from click even though its queued read has not settled; its late completion cannot clear a newer action. Current valid results still update the roster and background coalescing remains intact. Client switch retires old timers/results and cannot clear new client's action; cached timestamp and authority boundaries remain unchanged.

cases.description: Upload success requires a nonblank path before any complete mark, message send or draft clearing
cases.setup: Real GtmuxClient upload with controlled synthetic XHR; real Composer/uploadAll with a caption, two photos and controlled uploader responses
cases.action: Return HTTP2xx with empty/whitespace paths and valid paths containing ordinary spaces; inject invalid later-file success into uploadAll then explicitly retry the preserved batch
cases.expected: Empty/whitespace success is failed at both boundaries, never complete or sent; caption and both photos remain and no automatic retry occurs. An explicit double-tapped retry uses the existing in-flight guard and sends one valid message. Nonblank paths are preserved exactly and ordinary saved success remains complete only after response.
